## Produce plots and results for sensitivity analysis

### Libraries

```{r}
library(AgeReading)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
require(gridExtra)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(ggh4x)
source("../R/my_ggplot1.R")
source("../R/compare_samp.R")
```

### Load data and results

```{r}
Amin=3;Amax=12
A = Amax-Amin+1
R = 14

dir = "../../save_results/"
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0.year500000.RData"))              #reader dependent age errors
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0.year.sens100000.RData"))             #reader independent age errors

#Harmonic mean for marginal likelihood
foo0 = as.vector(extract(fitcomb0.year)$loglik)
ML0 = max(foo0)-log(mean(exp(-foo0+max(foo0))))
foo0sens = as.vector(extract(fitcomb0.year.sens)$loglik)
ML0sens = max(foo0sens)-log(mean(exp(-foo0sens+max(foo0sens))))

##Calculating number at age
data(Herring_D_boot)
data(HerringSurvey)

```

### Rename xi0 so ages become right

```{r}
library(stringr)
ind = grep("xi0",names(fitcomb0.year.sens))
foo = names(fitcomb0.year.sens)[ind]
for(i in 10:1)
{
  foo = str_replace_all(foo,paste0(",",i,"]"),paste0(",",i+2,"]"))
}
names(fitcomb0.year.sens)[ind] = foo
names(fitcomb0.year)[ind] = foo
foo2 = list()
foo3 = substring(foo,first=5,last=5)
foo4 = substring(foo,first=7,last=8)
foo4[1:15] = substring(foo4[1:15],first=1,last=1)
for(i in 1:length(foo))
  foo2[[i]] = substitute(expression(x[i,j]^0),list(i=foo3[i],j=foo4[i]))


##Rename M1 so ages become right
ind = grep("M1",names(fitcomb0.year.sens))
ind2 = matrix(nrow=length(ind),ncol=3)
i=0
for(a in 1:A)
  for(a2 in 1:A)
    for(r in 1:R)
    {
      i = i+1
      ind2[i,] = c(r,a+Amin-1,a2+Amin-1)
    }
names(fitcomb0.year.sens)[ind] = paste0("M1[",ind2[,1],",",ind2[,2],",",ind2[,3],"]")
names(fitcomb0.year)[ind] = paste0("M1[",ind2[,1],",",ind2[,2],",",ind2[,3],"]")
```


### Compute numbers at age

```{r}
Bootmean = Herring_D_boot[Herring_D_boot$BootstrapID<2,]
nunit = length(unique(Bootmean$unitstrat))
#Only using mean of bootstrap samples
for(i in 1:nunit)
{
  Bootmean$Abundance[Bootmean$unitstrat==i] = mean(Herring_D_boot$Abundance[Herring_D_boot$unitstrat==i])
  Bootmean$Biomass[Bootmean$unitstrat==i] = mean(Herring_D_boot$Biomass[Herring_D_boot$unitstrat==i])
}


foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0.year)$xi1
res0 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0.year.sens)$xi1
res0sens = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)


```

### Make plots of numbers at age

```{r}
dummy_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(1:2, levels = 1:2),
  x = 1:2,
  y = 1:2
)
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(2)
legend_plot <- ggplot(dummy_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    labels = c("Original hyp.","Modifided hyp.")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      override.aes = list(shape=15,size = 6)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

legend_grob2 <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
```


```{r}
M1 = extract(fitcomb0.year,pars="M1")$M1
M1mean = apply(M1,c(2,3,4),mean)


for(y in c(1,3))
{
mean0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
mean0sens = round(apply(res0sens[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
sd0sens = round(apply(res0sens[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
l = list()
ind = 0
#y = 2
for(a in 1:10)
{
  ind = ind+1
  df = data.frame(y=c(res0[,y,a],res0sens[,y,a]),
                  Method=c(rep(1,dim(res0)[1]),
                       rep(2,dim(res0sens)[1])))
  df$y = df$y/10^9
  df$Method = as.factor(df$Method)
  l[[ind]] = ggplot(df,aes(x=y,color=Method,fill=Method)) +
      geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Age=",a+Amin-1)) + xlab('') + ylab('') +
      scale_color_discrete(
        labels = c(
          paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
          paste0(mean0sens[a],"(",sd0sens[a],")"))) +
      scale_fill_discrete(
        labels = c(
          paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
          paste0(mean0sens[a],"(",sd0sens[a],")"))) +
      guides(
        color = guide_legend(title = NULL),
        fill  = guide_legend(title = NULL)
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = c(1,1),legend.justification = c(1, 1),
            legend.text=element_text(size=8),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "lines"),
            legend.title = element_blank())
    
  #l[[ind]] = my_ggplot2(df,a,mean0,mean0sens,sd0,sd0sens,Amin)

}
l[[11]] = legend_grob2
pdf(paste0("Nest_sens_202",y,".pdf"),height=5,width=10)
grid.arrange(grobs=l,layout_matrix=matrix(c(1:8,NA,9:11),nrow=3,byrow=T))
#grid.arrange(l[[1]],l[[2]],l[[3]],ncol=3,nrow=1)
dev.off()
}
```


### Make plots of xi0

```{r}
ages <- 3:12
for(y in 1:3)
{
  
  pars = paste0("xi0[",y,",",2+1:A,"]")
  xx =as.matrix(fitcomb0.year,pars=pars)
  xx2 = as.matrix(fitcomb0.year.sens,pars=pars)
  xxcomb = matrix(NA,nrow=nrow(xx),ncol=2*ncol(xx))
  colnames(xxcomb) = 1:(2*ncol(xx))
  for(j in 1:ncol(xx))
  {
    print(j)
    xxcomb[,2*j-1] = xx[,j]
    xxcomb[,2*j] = xx2[,j]
    colnames(xxcomb)[c(2*j-1,2*j)] = c(paste0("A-",j+2),paste0("B-",j+2))
  }
  xxcomb = xxcomb[,20:1]
  ## Names in A/B pairs for each age
  colnames(xxcomb) <- paste(
  rep(ages, each = 2),
  rep(c("A", "B"), times = length(ages)),
  sep = "::"
)
p = mcmc_intervals(xxcomb, prob = 0.8, prob_outer = 0.95) +
  labs(y = "Age", x = "Proportion") +
  scale_y_discrete(
    guide = guide_axis_nested(delim = "::")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22)
  ) +
  coord_flip()
  pdf(paste0("fit0_xi0_sens_202",y,".pdf"),height=4,width=4)
  print(p)
dev.off()
}
```



```{r}
comb = cbind(c(7,7,11,11),c(7,8,11,10))

for(k in 1:nrow(comb))
{
ind = 1:R
pars = paste0("M1[",ind,",",comb[k,1],",",comb[k,2],"]")
xx =as.matrix(fitcomb0.year,pars=pars)
xx2 = as.matrix(fitcomb0.year.sens,pars=pars)
xxcomb = matrix(NA,nrow=nrow(xx),ncol=2*ncol(xx))
colnames(xxcomb) = 1:(2*ncol(xx))
for(j in 1:ncol(xx))
{
  print(j)
  xxcomb[,2*j-1] = xx[,j]
  xxcomb[,2*j] = xx2[,j]
  colnames(xxcomb)[c(2*j-1,2*j)] = c(paste0("A-",j),paste0("B-",j))
}
xxcomb = xxcomb[,28:1]
p = mcmc_intervals(xxcomb,prob=0.8,prob_outer=0.95)+labs(y="Reader",x="Proportion")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=22),axis.title.y=element_text(size=22)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 12.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") 
pdf(paste0("fit0_M1_sens_",comb[k,1],"_",comb[k,2],".pdf"),height=4.5,width=4)
print(p)
dev.off()
}
```

### MCMC intervals for error matrix parameters

### Compare parameters

```{r}
parv = c("alpha0","beta0","alpha1","beta1","trphi")
foo3 = NULL
for(k in 1:length(parv))
{
pars=parv[k]
xx =as.matrix(fitcomb0.year,pars=pars)
xx2 =as.matrix(fitcomb0.year.sens,pars=pars)
xx3 = cbind(xx,xx2)
foo = compare_samp(xx3)
foo2 = NULL
for(r in 1:14){foo2 = c(foo2,foo[r,r+14])}
foo3 = c(foo3,foo2)
print(min(foo2))
}

```
